allow: PowerShell($localIP = \(Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 | Where-Object { $_.IPAddress -notmatch '^\(127\\.|169\\.\)' } | Sort-Object PrefixLength | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty IPAddress\); Write-Host "IP locale : $localIP")

PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:5000/api/health" -UseBasicParsing; Write-Host "API OK: $\($r.Content\)" } catch { Write-Host "Erreur: $_" }; try { $r2 = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:5000" -UseBasicParsing; Write-Host "Frontend OK: $\($r2.StatusCode\)" } catch { Write-Host "Erreur frontend: $_" })
